title: system.usage.summary Output
description: Output schema for the system.usage.summary module (PROTOCOL_SPEC 6.7.1). Every statistic below is computed over the requested `period` window, never over the full retained history.

period.description: The requested time window, echoed back. Matches ^[1-9][0-9]*[hd]$ (PROTOCOL_SPEC 6.7.1.1); every statistic in this document is computed over [now - period, now].

total_calls.description: Total calls across all modules within the period.

total_errors.description: Total failed calls across all modules within the period.

modules.description: Per-module usage entries within the period, sorted by call_count descending.

items.description: Usage statistics for one module over the period.

call_count.description: Calls to this module within the period.

error_count.description: Failed calls to this module within the period.

avg_latency_ms.description: Mean latency in milliseconds across the calls in the period. 0 when there are no calls.

unique_callers.description: Number of distinct caller_id values within the period. Calls with no caller identity are attributed to the literal 'unknown' and count as one such caller (PROTOCOL_SPEC 6.7.1.4).

trend.description: Direction of change against the immediately preceding window of equal length, per the normative table in PROTOCOL_SPEC 6.7.1.5.
